def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # normalize text: strip whitespace, fix label variants
    for c in d.columns:
        if d[c].dtype == object:
            d[c] = d[c].apply(lambda v: v.strip() if isinstance(v, str) else v)
    d['species'] = d['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    d['sex'] = d['sex'].replace({'FEMALE': 'female'})
    # coerce numeric-looking text to numbers
    for c in ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        d[c] = pd.to_numeric(d[c], errors='coerce')
    # out-of-range measurements -> missing (do not drop rows)
    d.loc[(d['bill_length_mm'] < 30) | (d['bill_length_mm'] > 60), 'bill_length_mm'] = float('nan')
    d.loc[(d['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (d['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = float('nan')
    d.loc[(d['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (d['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = float('nan')
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    d = d.drop_duplicates()
    return d


def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['island'])
    counts = d.groupby('island')['penguin_id'].count()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
